summary: Follow a guided loss of grid power at four fictional nuclear units, then inspect the evidence and restore their external supply.
about: Start paused with a guide that finds Unit 1, opens its live display and offers an editable Assistant prompt. Advance two minutes when ready, inspect the actual plant and grid response, then restore offsite power. Choose Explore for direct control. It shows Leitbild connecting plant, grid and guidance based on observations.

previews.alt: The grid around Halden after the fault, beside the grid panel showing the grid frequency in red below 49 Hz.

summary: Inspect a weakness in northern Norway’s grid, change one independent copy and compare both futures with a paced guide.
about: Start paused and inspect the northern grid with the guide. Create an independent copy, make the preventive change in one simulation, then advance both to the same time and compare their actual state. Choose Explore to investigate freely. It shows Leitbild supporting guided what-if comparisons while preserving the original.

previews.alt: Map of the Helgeland coast after a major line trip, with the smaller lines that tripped after it drawn as red dashes.

summary: Learn a fictional Halden dispatch desk with a paced guide, then send ambulances, patrol cars and fire engines to incoming calls.
about: Choose a desk or controller role and use the guide to find calls and dispatch an eligible unit. Shared time starts paused; agree readiness before starting it. Follow the actual unit to arrival, then continue the 30-minute exercise alone or with a colleague. It shows Leitbild configuring roles, units and calls through Einsatz, its general dispatch engine.

previews.alt: Map of Halden with ambulances, patrol cars and fire engines on their way to numbered calls.
